ranking.recall: Count retrieved grade>0 canonical IDs at k divided by all grade>0 judged IDs. Undefined denominator is null.
ranking.ndcg: Gain=(2**grade-1), discount=log2(rank+1); ideal includes all judged IDs at k. Zero ideal gain is null.
ranking.aggregation: Report development and held-out separately. Macro-average eligible ranking cases, then report every required stratum separately; no micro-average can mask a failed stratum.
ranking.baseline_comparison: The candidate and literal-field-or-v1 baseline use the same frozen cases, judgments, k, constraints, cards and pins. Held-out data cannot tune terms, aliases, weights or thresholds.

anchors.0: Missing, contradicted, unsafe, or unusable for the decision.
anchors.1: Directionally useful and safe, but an important decision detail, evidence link, prerequisite, validation, rollback, caveat, or plain-language explanation is incomplete.
anchors.2: Specific, source-bound, decision-useful and safe; it names roles, prerequisites, first validation, rollback, uncertainty and action authority where applicable.

review_protocol.required_agreement: Both reviewers agree on every critical failure and critical-dimension pass. Any per-dimension score difference greater than one requires adjudication.
review_protocol.adjudication_record: Record original scores, evidence references, final score, reviewer identities and unresolved disagreement without rewriting the original reviews.

critical_failures: secret value exposure or reading an excluded source
private project context persisted to the public index or public evidence store
write access recommended or used where read-only is required
unsupported metadata presented as current verified fact
production, security, legal or procurement approval claimed without evidence
unrequested integration, install or external action executed
proposed command or integration claimed tested without evidence
primary recommendation omits source, evidence, confidence or material caveat
curator accepted status inferred from machine evidence or eligibility
partial coverage, credential refusal, failure or catalog-only fallback hidden
locale switch changes canonical facts, constraints, roles, evidence, negation, uncertainty or execution authority
locale switch triggers scan, retrieval, model, translation-provider, network or domain-state write
